lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice telling a simple past story in sequence with först, sedan, and till slut.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: A Monday fika conversation about what happened during the weekend.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Narrating everyday events in a clear order.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik talk about a weekend activity and one small thing that happened along the way.

main_focus.name: preterite sequence with time markers
main_focus.description: Use preterite verbs with sequencing words to tell what happened first, next, and finally.
model_examples: Sedan fikade vi och till slut åkte vi hem.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use preterite sequence markers naturally 3-4 times in the dialogue.

allowed_supporting_grammar: basic V2 word order after time markers
avoid_grammar: past perfect as the main focus

useful_chunks: Det låter som en bra dag.
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use sequencing chunks to keep the story easy to follow.

dialogue_shape.opening: One person asks about the weekend.
dialogue_shape.middle: A short story is told in three clear steps with a reaction or follow-up.
dialogue_shape.ending: They summarize the outcome or feeling about the weekend.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat sequencing markers in a natural order

focus: what happened first in the weekend story
what happened next in the sequence

sentence_focus: one sentence starting with till slut
one question asking about the weekend
one sentence summarizing a past activity
